info.title: CSV Import & Report API
info.description:
Upload order CSVs, track asynchronous import jobs, and request asynchronous reports.

**Authentication (demo):** every request identifies the caller with the `X-User-Id` header (click *Authorize* and enter e.g. `alice`). Users only see their own imports and reports.

**Idempotency:** POST endpoints accept an optional `Idempotency-Key` header; repeating a request with the same key returns the original job instead of creating a new one.

post.summary: Upload a CSV file and start an asynchronous import.
post.description: Returns `202 Accepted` immediately with the import id; poll `GET /imports/{id}` for progress.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional key to make retries of this request safe

get.summary: Get the status and progress of an import.

404.description: Not found (or belongs to another user)

get.summary: List the invalid rows of an import and why each was rejected.
Download the originally uploaded CSV file from object storage.

410.description: The file was removed with storage-admin

get.summary: Readiness: database, message broker and object storage are reachable.

post.summary: Request an asynchronous report over your imported data.
post.description:
Returns `202 Accepted` immediately; poll `GET /reports/{id}` until `status` is `completed`,
then fetch the result from the response or `GET /reports/{id}/download`.

The set of imports is fixed when the report is requested: either the `import_ids` you pass
(all must be yours and completed) or, if omitted, all your completed imports.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional key to make retries of this request safe

requestBody.description: Optional; an empty body means all completed imports

404.description: An import id does not exist (or is not yours)

409.description: An import is not completed, or you have no completed imports

get.summary: Get the status of a report, including its summary (totals) once it is completed.
Download a completed report as CSV (default) or JSON. The file is served from object storage.

410.description: Report files were removed with storage-admin

AttemptInfo.description: One processing attempt of a job.

field.description: Column name, or `row` for problems with the row as a whole.

invalid_rows.description: Total invalid rows in the file.

stored_errors.description: Number of invalid rows whose details are stored (capped by MAX_STORED_ROW_ERRORS).

file_available.description: Whether the uploaded file is still in object storage (see `GET /imports/{id}/file`).

file_deleted_at.description: When the file was removed with `storage-admin` (imported rows are kept).

last_error.description: Error of the most recent failed attempt (or the final failure reason).

next_attempt_at.description: When the next attempt is scheduled (only while `retrying`).

total_rows.description: Data rows in the file (excluding the header). Null until processed.

import_ids.description: Imports to include. Omit (or send an empty body) to include all of your completed imports.

counted_statuses.description: Order statuses included in the totals.

excluded_invalid_rows.description: Invalid CSV rows (across the covered imports) that were excluded because they failed validation.

superseded_duplicate_orders.description: Rows superseded by the same order_id in a more recent import.

ReportResultSummary.description:
Everything about a report except its rows. Stored in Postgres and returned by
`GET /reports/{id}`; the full report (with rows) lives in object storage.

row_count.description: Number of rows (customers) in the report file.

files_available.description: Whether the report files are still in object storage.

files_deleted_at.description: When the report files were removed with `storage-admin`.

oneOf.description:
Totals and counts, present once the report is `completed`. The full report (every row)
is a file in object storage: see `links.download_csv` / `links.download_json`.

errors.description: Every validation error found in the row.

line_number.description: Line number in the uploaded file (header = line 1).

raw_record.description: The rejected row as it appeared in the file.

user_id.name: X-User-Id
user_id.description: Caller identity (demo auth). Letters, digits, '-', '_', '.', '@'; max 64 chars.
